Figure 1:Random-intercept variance by the groups of the axes for GPT-4o mini. The rows correspond toPsyncP_{\mathrm{sync}},HHandFF, the columns to
the text length, the density and the number of rules. Over the two remaining axes the variance is averaged over the requests. Whiskers
show±1.96\pm 1.96standard errors, curves are the approximations along the axes. ForPsyncP_{\mathrm{sync}}the model rejected by the median-request
check is shown (Subsection6.5).

Figure 2:Laws of the axes ofHH(top row) andFF(bottom row) for GPT-4o mini with a constant (blue) and a heterogeneous (orange)
random-intercept variance. Points show the coefficients of the bins relative to the reference bin with 95% intervals, lines are the
laws.
